entries.title: I Corinthians 14:1
segments: Follow after love and desire spiritual [things], but rather that you may prophesy.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:2
segments: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men but to God. For no one hears, but in spirit he speaks mysteries.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:3
segments: But he who prophesies speaks to men [for] building up, and exhortation, and comfort.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:4
segments: The one speaking in a tongue builds himself up, but he prophesying builds up a church.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:5
segments: I wish all of you to speak in languages, but rather that you may prophesy; for greater [is] he prophesying than he speaking in tongues, unless he interpret so that the church may receive building up.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:6
segments: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what will I profit you, except I speak to you either in revelation, or in knowledge, or in prophecy, or in teaching?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:7
segments: Yet lifeless things giving a sound, whether flute or harp, if they do not give a distinction in the sound, how will it be known what is being piped or harped?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:8
segments: For also if a trumpet gives an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself for the battle?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:9
segments: So also you, if you do not give a clear word through the language, how will it be known what [is] being said? For you will be speaking into the air.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:10
segments: So it may be many kinds of sounds are in [the] world, and not one [is] without a distinct sound.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:11
segments: Therefore if I do not know the power of the sound, I will be a foreigner to him speaking, and he speaking [will be] a foreigner to me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:12
segments: Even so you, since you are zealots of spiritual [things], seek to build up the church, in order that you may abound

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:13
segments: So then he speaking in a language, let him pray that he may interpret.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:14
segments: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:15
segments: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will also pray with the mind; I will sing with the spirit, and I will also sing with the mind.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:16
segments: Else, if you bless in the spirit, he occupying the place of the unlearned, how will he say the amen at your giving of thanks, since he does not know what you say?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:17
segments: For you truly give thanks well, but the other is not built up.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:18
segments: I thank my God [that] I speak more languages than all of you;

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:19
segments: yet in a church I desire to speak five words with my mind, so that I might also teach others, than ten thousand words in a tongue.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:20
segments: Brothers, do not be children in your minds, but in malice be like infants, and in your minds be mature.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:21
segments: In the law it is written, "By other tongues and other lips I will speak to this people, and even so they will not hear Me, says the Lord."

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:22
segments: So that tongues are not a sign to those who believe, but to those who do not believe. But prophesying [is] not to those who do not believe, but to those who believe.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:23
segments: Therefore if the whole church has come together, and all speak in languages, and if uninstructed ones or unbelievers come in, will they not say that you rave?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:24
segments: But if all prophesy, and some unbeliever or one not instructed comes, he is convicted by all, he is judged by all.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:25
segments: And so the secrets of his heart become revealed. And so, falling down on [his] face, he will worship God and report that God is truly among you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:26
segments: Then how is it, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be for building up.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:27
segments: If one speaks in a language, [let it be] by two, or [at] the most three, and in succession. And let one interpret.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:28
segments: But if there is no interpreter, let him be silent in a church; and let him speak to himself and to God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:29
segments: And [if there are] two or three prophets, let them speak, and let the others judge.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:30
segments: If [a revelation] is revealed to another sitting by, let the first be silent.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:31
segments: For you may all prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all may be comforted.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:32
segments: And the spirits of the prophets [are] subject to the prophets.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:33
segments: For God is not [the author] of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:34
segments: Let your women be silent in the churches; for it is not permitted to them to speak, but to be in subjection, as the Law also says.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:35
segments: And if they desire to learn anything, let them ask their husbands at home; for it is a shame for a woman to speak in a church.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:36
segments: Or did the Word of God go out from you? Or did it reach only to you?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:37
segments: If anyone thinks to be a prophet, or a spiritual one, let him recognize the things I write to you, that they are a commandment of the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:38
segments: But if any is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:39
segments: So then, brothers, seek to prophesy, and do not forbid to speak in languages.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:40
segments: Let all things be done decently and in order.
